Container.Name: openRSS
Container.Overview: A quiet, self-hosted RSS reader with AI that works for you. openRSS groups duplicate stories, scores each article from 0 to 100 by your interests, summarizes, translates and builds a daily digest, using OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter or a local model through Ollama. Also: OPML import/export, automatic rules with ntfy/Discord/Slack/Telegram notifications, OIDC single sign-on, and the Google Reader and Fever APIs for NetNewsWire, Reeder, ReadYou and other apps.[br][br]After install, open the WebUI and create your account: the first account becomes the administrator.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Config, secret and the SQLite database.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: SQLite in the data folder (up to ~5 concurrent users). For PostgreSQL: postgresql://user:password@host:5432/openrss

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy or for single sign-on: the address users open, e.g. https://rss.example.com. Leave empty to accept the address in the browser.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder.

Config.Name: Allow private feeds
Config.Description: Allow feeds on your local network (e.g. other containers).

Config.Name: Allow private webhooks
Config.Description: Allow rule notifications to local addresses (e.g. a self-hosted ntfy).

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Optional: e-mail for password reset and the daily digest.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: Optional single sign-on (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak). Requires Public URL.
